boundaries.source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) and OCHA ROAP via geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM2-ADM4
boundaries.source_dataset: HDX: Administrative boundaries of Bangladesh as of 2015
boundaries.unions: ADM4 polygons assigned to the upazila containing their representative point; IDs are <upazila pcode>-U<nnn>, not official BBS codes

classes.public_hospital: hospital type with government, autonomous or semi-autonomous ownership
classes.private_ngo_hospital: every other hospital-type record, including missing ownership

method.distance: straight-line km from grid cell centres to the nearest usable point; shares of land area
